description: Defines configuration structures, enums, and functions for RLC (Radio Link Control) modes in a wireless communication system, including UM, AM, and TM modes, with associated timers, window sizes, and protocol-specific parameters.

methods.name: to_number
methods.description: Converts enum class rlc_um_sn_size or rlc_am_sn_size to its numeric value.

methods.name: from_number
methods.description: Converts a numeric value to enum class rlc_um_sn_size or rlc_am_sn_size.

methods.name: rlc_t_reassembly_from_int
methods.description: Converts an integer to rlc_t_reassembly enum if valid.

methods.name: rlc_t_poll_retransmit_from_int
methods.description: Converts an integer to rlc_t_poll_retransmit enum if valid.

methods.name: rlc_max_retx_threshold_from_int
methods.description: Converts an integer to rlc_max_retx_threshold enum if valid.

methods.name: rlc_poll_pdu_from_int
methods.description: Converts an integer to rlc_poll_pdu enum if valid.

methods.name: rlc_poll_kilo_bytes_from_int
methods.description: Converts an integer to rlc_poll_kilo_bytes enum if valid.

methods.name: rlc_t_status_prohibit_from_int
methods.description: Converts an integer to rlc_t_status_prohibit enum if valid.

methods.name: cardinality
methods.description: Returns the number of possible sequence numbers for a given sn_size in bits.

methods.name: window_size
methods.description: Returns the window size based on sn_size, as per 3GPP TS 38.322 Sec. 7.2.
